text:
Lena: Sprint task 9: overhaul battlecard for infra teams evaluating managed LLM endpoints vs Redwood Dedicated/Private. Need: 1-page battlecard, AE CSV for routing, and 2 webinar slides (bench + demo).
Omar: Sales feedback: keep rebuttals one-liners + a single artefact link for proof. They hate long paragraphs.
Zoe: Draft objection list: 'tail latency', 'cost unpredictability', 'data residency', 'rollouts/versioning', 'vendor lock-in'.
Tess: For tail latency rebuttal: 'Dedicated pools + workload-aware batching + KV cache = stable p95 under burst. Fallback routing keeps user experience intact.'
Caleb: Cost rebuttal soundbite: 'Committed capacity + quant profiles + caching can halve per-token spend vs multi-tenant bursts.' Example: show $/MM tokens before/after.
Lena: We also need a routing tag system in the CSV so inbound leads hit the right AE queue: tags = infra, security, cost-sensitive, latency.
Omar: I'll create the CSV template and preload likely objections as rows. Columns: objection,rebuttal,proof_link,routing_tag,demo_step.
Zoe: Add a one-line "how-to-demo" that AEs can run in 90s. e.g., 'Trigger 10x QPS spike, show p95 graph for managed, then flip routing to Dedicated.'
Tess: Webinar slides: slide 1 = benchmark overview (p50/p95/p99, $/MM tokens), slide 2 = live demo plan + key talking points.
Caleb: Ops note: I can run a head-to-head bench tomorrow. Recommend model: Llama-2-70b, seq=512, steady 60rps then 600rps for 45s.
ops-bot: Bench job scheduled: bench/230111/rlm70b-512-run. Artifacts uploaded to https://ci.redwood/bench/230111/artifacts
Lena: Perfect. Zoe, can you draft the micro-rebuttals (3 versions: technical, executive, field) for each objection? Keep each under 25 words.
Zoe: On it. Example for vendor lock-in:
Technical: 'Model/serving abstraction + pinned versions and multi-variant routing prevents lock-in while enabling consistent APIs.'
Executive: 'Avoid being tied to one provider; deploy where it makes business sense.'
Field: 'You can pin model versions per route and rollback in minutes.'
Omar: CSV live example row (pasteable):
```
objection,rebuttal,proof_link,routing_tag,demo_step
"Why not ProviderZ managed endpoints?","Managed endpoints can spike in multi-tenant bursts; Dedicated + caching keeps p95 stable.","https://ci.redwood/bench/230111/p95.png",infra,"Trigger spike & flip routing to Dedicated"
```
Tess: Also include a compliance micro-rebuttal: 'Private deployment w/ VPC, KMS/HSM and audit logs; on-prem option for fully air-gapped needs.'
Caleb: Uploading Grafana screenshots now. Link: https://ci.redwood/bench/230111/grafana-dash.png
Lena: Timeline: CSV + one-pager draft by EOD tomorrow, slides by Thursday. Who's blocked?
Zoe: None. I'll drop micro-rebuttals to /marketing/drafts/battlecards/ by tonight.
Omar: CSV template uploaded to /marketing/ops/inbound-routing/csvs/battlecard-230111.csv
Lena: Great. Final ask 1: add 30-40 word elevator pitch at top of battlecard AEs can memorize for trade shows. I'll produce 3 variants and post them in #marketing-drafts.
Tess: Suggested elevator: 'Redwood makes inference predictable and economical across hosted, dedicated and private deployments so product teams ship reliable LLM features without building infra.'
Caleb: Love it. ops-bot: bench run finished, artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/230111/artifacts/summary.json
Lena: Thanks all. We'll iterate in the draft channel and finalize for the webinar. :rocket:
